description: A four channel stereo mixer, each channel with a level knob, a level CV and a direct output that takes it out of the main mix

params.text: Sets the level of that channel, from silence to unity
Sends a channel whose L(M) jack alone is patched to both main outputs; switched off, such a channel reaches the left output only

inputs.text: The left input of that channel, or its only input when the R jack of the same channel is empty
The right input of that channel
Multiplies that channel's level, 10V giving the level the knob is set to and 0V silence; a patched cable sitting at 0V silences the channel whatever the knob says

outputs.text: The left main output, carrying every channel whose own output jack is empty
The right main output, carrying every channel whose own output jack is empty
The left and right inputs of that channel summed to one signal after the level knob and CV; patching here removes that channel from both main outputs

notes: a channel with a cable in its own output jack is taken out of the main mix, so the module doubles as four separate voltage controlled amplifiers
monophonic: only the first channel of any cable is read
